name: manual_5061e2
claim: A passing focused pytest selection is insufficient as a completion gate when duplicate test function names can shadow earlier cases; require unique test definitions and record whether the repository-wide required gate passed, failed on baseline debt, or was not run.

decisions.notes: Task 5 had passing focused tests while three later duplicate test definitions silently replaced earlier coverage. The strict repository skill gate also remained non-green for unrelated baseline findings, so the task could not honestly be called fully validated.

rationale: Task 5 had passing focused tests while three later duplicate test definitions silently replaced earlier coverage. The strict repository skill gate also remained non-green for unrelated baseline findings, so the task could not honestly be called fully validated.
